text:
deploy-bot: starting release window. Targets: API=2.5.0, Runtime=3.14 (kernel batching), Router=2.7, Console=1.10. Proposed: staggered waves to reduce blast radius. /assign @Zoe @Raj

Zoe: runtime kernel batching looks good in perf lab but we saw kv-cache churn at high seq lengths. Recommend runtime + API first, keep router/console deferred.

Raj: router team saw a transient p99 spike in canary yesterday under connection churn. Holding router makes sense.

Priya: ops request: if we decouple, please publish exact roll order so we can update automations.

release-coordinator: new plan: Wave A -> API+Runtime (2% US canary, 20m). Wave B -> Router+Console next maintenance window. Will publish notes and pin compatibility tests.

ops: pinned router to 2.6.20 for this window and set alerting hooks: per-route p99, tcp_reset_rate, kv_evictions.

deploy-bot: canary started at 2% US for API+Runtime. Monitors: @slo-watch, @pagerduty. Canary length 20m.

(10m) Zoe: telemetry: p95 stable, p99 ~170ms on canary routes, kv_evictions normal.

(20m) Raj: canary green. Promoting to 20% global (EU excluded).

release-coordinator: documenting rollout and rollback criteria: p99 > 350ms for 10m or error rate > 1% for 5m -> rollback runtime to 3.13. Fallback binary verified.

deploy-bot: API+Runtime at 20% global, Router/Console deferred. Closing thread  follow-up scheduled by release-coordinator. :white_check_mark:
